notes.constitutional_independence: Judiciary has constitutional independence; complaints are routed mainly through judicial oversight bodies (NJC/FJSC), court administration, and rights watchdogs. Avoid contempt of court: focus on administrative misconduct, delay, corruption, registry failure, or rights violations.
to_vs_cc_rule_for_petitiondesk: TO = the PRIMARY responsible institution in your case (usually the specific Court / Court Registry / NJC/FJSC depending on issue).
CC = oversight/watchdogs (PCC for maladministration, NHRC for rights issues, etc.).

federal_ministry_of_justice.name: Federal Ministry of Justice
federal_ministry_of_justice.role: Justice-sector coordination, federal legal policy; Attorney-General of the Federation functions sit here (AGF).

core_judicial_oversight_and_service_bodi.name: Federal Judicial Service Commission (FJSC)
core_judicial_oversight_and_service_bodi.type: Judicial service body (federal judicial appointments/admin matters as applicable)

courts_and_registry_targets.name: Supreme Court of Nigeria
aliases: Supreme Court of the Federal Republic of Nigeria

courts_and_registry_targets.name: High Court (State) / Chief Judge (State)
courts_and_registry_targets.notes: State judiciaries differ by state. Keep a separate state_judiciary.json later (Abuja/FCT, Lagos, Kano, etc.).

watchdogs.name: Public Complaints Commission (PCC)
watchdogs.role: Maladministration, refusal to act, delay in administrative duties, poor service delivery in public institutions (including court registry/administration complaints).

watchdogs.name: National Human Rights Commission (NHRC)
watchdogs.role: Human rights violations (unlawful detention, torture, denial of bail, fair-hearing concerns, abuse by justice-chain actors).

judicial_titles_guidance: Use office titles, not personal names (e.g., 'The Chairman, NJC', 'The Chief Registrar', 'The President, Court of Appeal').
Avoid insulting language; stick to facts, dates, and evidence.
If your matter is still pending in court, frame complaint as ADMINISTRATIVE/MALADMINISTRATION (e.g., registry delay, missing file, refusal to process) not as attacking the judge’s decision.

primary_to_rules.when: Registry delay / missing case file / refusal to compile record / CTC delay
primary_to_rules.to: The Chief Registrar / Registrar of the Court (relevant court)

primary_to_rules.when: Judicial misconduct / bribery / abuse of office / bias (disciplinary complaint)
Unlawful detention / denial of bail / torture / police disobedience of court order
primary_to_rules.to: NHRC (rights complaint) OR relevant justice-chain authority
cc: NJC (if judicial admin issue is involved)

evidence_checklist: Chronology (dates of filing, hearing, adjournments, rulings)
Receipts/proof of payment (filing fees, CTC, service fees)
Names/titles of officials involved (Registrar/Clerk/Chief Registrar) — titles preferred
Any written responses, emails, SMS, WhatsApp messages
Proof of harm caused by delay (missed deadlines, detention days, financial loss)
